Isolated source rank-k pipeline depth by retaining square 256x256/2x1 MN_SW64 C/D staging but restoring occupancy-one shared allocation. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch2/n4096 measured 1769.337 us with one 11.597 ms outlier and best 1715.200 us; the mean was 2.189 us below occupancy-two SW64 Trial2 but its clean floor was 6.640 us slower than Trial2's 1708.560. Aggregate was outlier-inflated to 770.057 us by untouched n256/n1024 cells versus Trial2's 750.925. No additional hosted profile was launched.

Aggregate measured 775.183 us amid broad untouched-cell drift. No additional hosted profile was launched.

Continued the occupancy-two square source-only D-store layout bracket by changing MN_SW64 to MN_SW128 while retaining default C loads and every graph/dispatch decision. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch2/n4096 measured 1807.943 us with one 13.047 ms outlier and best 1734.144 us, regressing 40.590/26.208 us from D-only SW64 Trial5. Aggregate measured 753.792 us versus Trial5's 749.009. No additional hosted profile was launched.

Completed the built-in occupancy-two square source-only D-store layout bracket with MN_SW32 while retaining default C loads and all graph/dispatch state. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch2/n4096 reached the branch-low single sample 1706.032 us, 1.904 us below D-only SW64 Trial5, but mean 1831.898 us included one 23.749 ms outlier; excluding it gives about 1721.76 us versus SW64's about 1720.11 us. Aggregate was outlier-inflated to 771.563 us versus SW64's branch-best 749.009. No additional hosted profile was launched.

Raised the D-only MN_SW64 square source rank-k pipeline target from occupancy two to three while preserving all graph and dispatch state. The wrapped local build passed because CuTe compilation is GPU-conditional, but wrapped Modal validation failed at import before test0: occupancy-three left zero A/B pipeline stages and CuTe rejected a strictly nonpositive shared layout shape. No GPU validation or benchmark metric was produced. The invalid source will be reset to the known-good occupancy-two D-only SW64 commit before another trial; no hosted profile was launched.

Completed the valid D-only MN_SW64 square source rank-k occupancy bracket by lowering the pipeline target from two to one, retaining default C loads and all graph/dispatch state. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch2/n4096 measured 1781.307 us with one 11.578 ms outlier and best 1724.880 us; outlier-excluded mean was about 1732.08 us versus occupancy-two Trial5's about 1720.11 and clean floor 1707.936. Aggregate measured 749.447 us, close to Trial5's 749.009 due favorable unrelated cells. Occupancy three was compile-invalid at Trial8. No additional hosted profile was launched.

Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch2/n4096 measured 1832.607 us with one 17.696 ms outlier and best 1743.952 us, regressing 65.254/36.016 us from standard occupancy-two D-only SW64 Trial5. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full 15-cell grid passed. Aggregate measured 825.821 us. This isolates later in-place stages as unfavorable for the source-specialized operator. No additional hosted profile was launched.

Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 765.214 us. Batch2/n4096 measured 1836.849 us with one 21.775 ms outlier, best 1726.528 us, and outlier-excluded mean about 1736.7 us versus heuristic Trial5 about 1720.1 us and 1707.936 best. Extra store buffering does not recover the lost C-load overlap in this measured form. No additional hosted profile was launched.

Completed the asymmetric occupancy-two D-only MN_SW64 pipeline bracket by shifting the source rank-k to three C/one D stages with one A/B and two accumulator stages, retaining first-stage-only dispatch and the complete graph. Wrapped build, all tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. The first full run was globally throttled across all unchanged cells at 1273.827 us, so the unchanged candidate received one complete repeat; that repeat measured 806.415 us aggregate. Batch2/n4096 repeat mean was 1869.459 us with one 26.985 ms outlier, best 1723.840 us, and outlier-excluded mean about 1743.3 us. Its best trails heuristic two-C/two-D Trial5 by 15.904 us; the first throttled run was 3035.446/2802.160 us. No additional hosted profile was launched.

Integrated the profiled direct-source batch2/n4096 graph onto c651e580 and explored 14 logged trials. Best measured candidate is exact Trial5 commit 844d2afc02377375f2ba76746c80ab4e1ca59a72: the source-only 256x256/2x1 rank-k targets occupancy two, keeps default C staging, uses MN_SW64 only for D staging, and remains limited to the first distinct-C/D stage; all later independent stages and the three-stage batched tail retain their imported operators. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. It measured 749.009 us aggregate versus integrated Trial0 751.889 and parent 745.689; batch2/n4096 was 1767.353 us with one 11.168 ms outlier, 1707.936 us best, and about 1720.1 us excluding the outlier, versus Trial0 1778.534/1709.056. Both-SW64 measured 750.925/1708.560 best; C-only, D-only SW128, D-only SW32, occupancy one, explicit occupancy three, all-stage source dispatch, one-C/three-D, and three-C/one-D measured target bests 1739.792, 1734.144, 1706.032, 1724.880, 1743.952, 1760.992, 1726.528, and 1723.840 us respectively, with SW32's clean mean worse than SW64. Heuristic occupancy three failed compilation and was separately logged. The sole authorized hosted profile was exact Trial0/index11, job 48ffc9b120e64d89bbb4423e6783b43d: source rank-k 29.76 us, 78 registers, 230.40 KiB shared, 9.46 percent occupancy, 81.31 percent no-eligible, and 1.8x/1.4x shared conflicts; canonical artifacts end in 93bc00a9 under profiles/2026-07-19-01-44-06-cholesky-resumed-local-unmerged. Local profiling is waived and no second hosted request was made. Keep this line moving with a legal three-accumulator/two-resident square pipeline, occupancy-two D-SW64 combined with equal-priority queues, custom shared padding beyond built-in SW32/64/128 atoms, or a future longer capture that reaches later independent stages before assigning them specialized operators.
